keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Twente 0, Ajax 1. Tolu Arokodare (Ajax) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Oscar Gloukh with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Wout Weghorst (Twente).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Lucas Rosa (Ajax) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Twente 0, Ajax 1.
Tolu Arokodare (Ajax) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Ajax. Rayane Bounida replaces Davy Klaassen.
Substitution, Ajax. Sofyan Amrabat replaces Yves Bissouma.
Robin Pröpper (Twente) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Aaron Bouwman (Ajax) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Twente 0, Ajax 2. Rayane Bounida (Ajax) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Oscar Gloukh.
Own Goal by Dies Janse, Ajax. Twente 1, Ajax 2.
Substitution, Twente. Marko Pjaca replaces Younes Taha.
Oscar Gloukh (Ajax) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Ajax. Daley Blind replaces Youri Baas because of an injury.
Daouda Weidmann (Twente) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Twente. Lucas Vennegoor of Hesselink replaces Aske Adelgaard.
Substitution, Twente. Thomas van den Belt replaces Daouda Weidmann.
Substitution, Ajax. Marcos Leonardo replaces Tolu Arokodare.
Substitution, Ajax. Abdellah Ouazane replaces Oscar Gloukh.
Ramiz Zerrouki (Twente) is shown the yellow card.
Owen Wijndal (Ajax) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Twente 2, Ajax 2. Wout Weghorst (Twente) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
